messages:
Ellen: Quick heads-up 
planning a terraform apply in the release quiet window 2026-01-12 04:00 UTC. Changes: NAT gateway adjustments, VPC route replacements, and an IAM role principal change. Need provider pin + canary plan. Anyone object? :wave:
Marco: No objections. Strongly recommend pinning the AWS provider in the root module to avoid accidental bumps. Also propose a one-region canary then staged roll. :eyes:
TJ: +1. Let's also have an evacuation fallback: if route changes break egress we should be ready to drain affected hosts and switch to fallback routes. Keep per-region apply windows to 20m.
Marco: Provider snippet proposal:
```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 4.75"
    }
  }
}
```
TJ: I'll own canary validation. Smoke script (will push to CI today):
```bash
# smoke-canary.sh
set -e
http_code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.prod.example/health)
[ "$http_code" = "200" ] || exit 2
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/canary-smoke --role-session-name canaryTest || exit 3
```
deploybot: change window reserved by @Ellen for 2026-01-12 04:00 UTC 
no overlapping deploys allowed. Required checks: tf fmt, tf validate, plan approval. Reminder scheduled 30m before window start.
infra-bot: terraform plan (detached) completed 
summary: additions=7, changes=2, deletions=1. Notable: prod-vpc route replace, update to iam/trust-policy. plan: https://ci.internal/plans/1839997777
Ellen: Rollback/triggers proposal: if packet loss >0.5% OR 5xx rate >0.3% sustained for 10m during canary, trigger revert apply and notify oncall. Prepare revert plan: exact `terraform apply` with previous state and targeted resource restores.
Marco: infra-bot please create a tfstate snapshot and tag with release id so revert is straightforward.
infra-bot: snapshot job queued -> snapshot created: s3://redwood-backups/2026-01-12/release-1839997777.tfstate.gz
oncall: Acknowledge 
will be standby and ready to execute rollback. :fire_extinguisher:
TJ: I'll add the canary validation checks to pb-monitor and post the threshold dashboards link. Also will add the assume-role smoke to CI as a pre-apply gate.
Marco: I'll add a one-line revert outline to the runbook and upload the revert plan file (revert-1839997777.md). Keep apply per-region to 20m to limit blast radius.
Ellen: Assigning owners: Ellen = release owner & runbook, Marco = provider pin + tfstate snapshot steward, TJ = canary validation + smoke script, oncall = rollback executor, docs-bot = release notes stub.
docs-bot: Release notes draft created: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-01-12 
Include note: "IAM trust update for cross-account deployer; expected no downtime, minor egress propagation window."
Ellen: Thanks team 
I'll lock merges 30m before the window :lock: and post final runbook + links tonight.
